That is such an odd error.  Would you mind sending the sessionInfo() output please?


On Wed, Aug 13, 2014 at 2:58 PM, Michael Kramer <mkr...@casestack.com> wrote:
I currently have an application that is functioning correctly locally, but when I attempt to deploy the application I am receiving the below error: 

deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Error in headers[["Content-Type"]] : subscript out of bounds

Can you please point me in the correct direction to receive resolution on this?

Thank you,

Michael

I struggled with that same error, which I think -- but am not sure -- was owed to a problem in deploying an app that used methods in my own non-CRAN package.

The app otherwise ran fine -- without any complaints -- on my local machine.

In my case, I removed the package, cleaned the environment, put the needed code from the package in an .R file, source()-ed that .R file, and then deployed the app with no problem.
